title: Salted Caramel Peanut Granola
changes_from_base: A quick home-made caramel sauce (sugar, cream and butter) is whisked into the oil and maple syrup with plenty of salt, coating oats and peanuts that are pressed flat and baked into chunks.
summary: A salted caramel granola with peanuts, delivering deep butterscotch notes with a hint of sea salt and the richness of slow-roasted nuts.
equipment: large rimmed baking tray (about 33 x 46 cm)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Caramel
steps.text: In a medium heavy-based saucepan, heat 150 g caster sugar and 60 ml water over medium heat, swirling (not stirring) until deep amber, about 8-10 min; remove from the heat and slowly whisk in 120 ml double cream (it will foam up), then 28 g unsalted butter; pour into a heatproof jug and let cool for 10 min.

steps.title: Preheat
steps.text: Heat the oven to 165 °C (145 °C fan), shelf just above the middle, and line a large rimmed baking tray with baking paper.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk the cooled caramel, 120 ml vegetable oil, 80 ml maple syrup, 4 tsp vanilla and 1½ tsp fine salt together in a large bowl.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Fold in 425 g rolled oats and 285 g unsalted dry-roasted peanuts roughly chopped until thoroughly coated.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Tip onto the lined tray, spread thinly and press down very firmly with a stiff metal spatula into an even sheet.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 40-45 min, turning the tray round after 20 min, until it is a light golden colour.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Remove and cool on a wire rack for 1 h, then break into pieces.

tips: Make the caramel before you preheat the oven so it has time to cool
Whisk the cream slowly and carefully into the hot caramel to prevent splashing
Use dry-roasted peanuts rather than raw ones for maximum flavour and crunch
storage: Store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
